name: KT Bakery
signature_dish: Fresh bread, cookies & cakes from the oven
why_it_matters: The only Lunglei eatery with a verifiable Tripadvisor presence (#1 of 1 Bakery in Lunglei) and consistent local reputation. Family-run — the owner or a family member is always on site. In a town where Tripadvisor lists only one restaurant total (Infoculty, 0 reviews), KT Bakery is genuinely the one verified anchor for tea, fresh bread, and celebration cakes.
insider_tip: Centrally located near Civil Hospital — taxi drivers know the landmark. Custom orders (birthdays, anniversaries) need a day's notice. Sundays are church-quiet across Lunglei; bakery usually shuts. Phone: +91 96151 41504.
signature_address: Chanmari-II, near Civil Hospital, Lunglei, Mizoram 796701
